toolLengthMethod.description: Tool length measurement method (0=Fixed position, 1=Surface plate)

ATCType.description: ATC types supported by the system

isAlwaysOnTop.description: Whether the main window is currently set to always stay on top

axisType.description: Axis label (X, Y, Z, A, B, C, U, V, W)

hasExtensionBoard.description: Whether an extension board is installed
